name: s3-standard
note: ASSUMED, not calibrated. PUT: third-party published figures (Turso): 4 KB object mean 31 ms, p95 60, p99 102; 512 KB p99 233 ms — used as p999. GET/HEAD/LIST/DELETE: rough estimates from AWS's S3 performance optimisation guide ('first-byte latency 100–200 ms' in the tail), no measurements of our own yet. Throttling: 3 500 writes / 5 500 reads per second per prefix (AWS, read 2026-10); a new bucket has one partition; how fast S3 splits a prefix is assumed (60 s). Written 2026-10-12.

put.note: includes conditional PUTs (If-Match / If-None-Match) — no separate figures yet

all.note: copy, rename — cairn barely uses them

slowdown.note: client_retry simulates the 5xx retry loop of the S3 client cairn builds (object_store 0.14: 10 attempts, backoff 100 ms ×2 with jitter, capped at 15 s; 30 s in total — S3_CLIENT_RETRY_TIMEOUT) — exactly what a real node sees
